writeup.key_factor: Cleanest name of the Sunday: both quarterbacks confirmed (Bryce Young and Tyler Shough play), at home in the dome, and the model makes New Orleans a 53.0% winner against a 51.9% market price - it clears the loosened Platinum entry band exactly (edge +1.1, EV +2.1%).
writeup.risk: The Saints offensive line plays without center Erik McCoy and tackle Taliese Fuaga, and Alvin Kamara was listed questionable (back) in one report - interior pressure on Shough is the counter-thesis. The edge is thin (+1.1): at any price worse than -108 the entry band breaks.

writeup.key_factor: The only first-pass gate clear of the day (edge +7.2 over the NCAAF GOLD gate of 3.0) with QB Trinidad Chambliss confirmed in. Re-rate by scenarios: blended 52.5% gives EV +16.0%; a haircut to 48% still gives EV +6.1%; only at Pinnacle's fair 44.5% does it die (EV -1.7%). It survives the haircut, so it plays - as GOLD, not Platinum, because the verified news runs against the model.
writeup.risk: FLAG gap +22.1, the largest of the day. Star RB Kewan Lacy is out for the season (dislocated shoulder, 3rd straight game out), OL Patrick Kutas is out, 11 Rebels are out in total, and Ole Miss lost 42-7 to Georgia last week. All-day rain in Norman (88-94%, 42-43F, gusts 16-21 mph, under the formal veto thresholds) hurts a backup ground game. Confidence is capped by the flag; the real numbers are declared, not dressed up.

writeup.key_factor: Second-pass NEVER EMPTY pick to complete the Gold minimum of 2: Charlotte plays without Kon Knueppel and Dennis Schroder (both out, hamstring), and the model still makes the Clippers a 51.5% home winner at -103 with a real, declared EV of +1.5%.
writeup.risk: Low confidence, entry band: the edge (+0.8) sits under the GOLD gate of 3.0 and the EV is thin. The Clippers are 3-8 and play without Bradley Beal and Brandon Ingram; Brandon Miller returns for Charlotte. This is the best real candidate left in the spectrum, with its real numbers shown.
